first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A dark, long gun-shaped object that sways with the viewpoint along the bottom edge of the image, with a wider near end and a slender, elongated front end.

entities.name: damp, debris-strewn corridor floor
entities.identification: The dark floor leading between the walls on both sides toward the doorway at the far end, with light-colored debris scattered across it and reflective wet areas.

entities.name: peeling two-tone corridor wall
entities.identification: The corridor walls on both sides, lighter above and dark gray-green below, with irregular paint boundaries and peeling edges.

entities.name: open doorway at the far end of the corridor
entities.identification: The rectangular doorway at the end of the corridor connecting to a brighter room, with a dark door panel on the left obscuring part of the entrance.

entities.name: square wall light at the far end
entities.identification: A small, bright white, nearly square light fixture on the wall above and to the left of the doorway.

entities.name: dark panel cabinet leaning diagonally against the right wall
entities.identification: Using the shared name, this refers to the dark, frame-like object near the right wall; in the first frame, only a diagonal edge strip at the right edge is visible.

entities.name: group of equipment cabinets behind the doorway
entities.identification: Gray-green cabinet-like equipment in the room behind the doorway, with rectangular sections and small square panels on the front.

entities.name: damaged suspended ceiling
entities.identification: The remaining light-gray panels, rectangular gaps, and exposed support framework at the top of the corridor.

entities.name: exposed corridor piping
entities.identification: Long pipes of varying thickness arranged lengthwise along the upper part of the right wall, with some pipe sections turning at the wall-ceiling junction.

entities.name: hanging corridor cables
entities.identification: Thin black cables hanging near a gap on the left side of the suspended ceiling, including a long, narrow hanging cable loop.

entities.name: scattered corridor debris
entities.identification: A collection of light-gray broken panels, long narrow strips, irregular fragments, and fine debris on the floor.

entities.name: standing water on the corridor floor
entities.identification: Irregularly distributed areas of dark, reflective standing water in the center of the floor and among the debris.
